title: Principal RF Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts.  Metrea specializes in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.

Position Summary

RADLAB is looking for a Principal RF Engineer to own the RF front-end design for our advanced integrated sensing-and-communications (ISAC) design, test and evaluation (DT&E) platform. You will be responsible for the signal chain from the antenna element port inward through the analog-digital interface, complementing our principal antenna engineer who owns the radiating elements and array design. Together, you will define and maintain a clean interface between the antenna and RF front-end domains.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with significant technical leadership responsibility. You will translate system-level requirements into producible RF hardware, starting from trade studies through schematic capture, simulation, PCB layout, fabrication oversight, and bench validation. You will work directly with our prototype engineer to bring up and characterize hardware. The DT&E platform requires RF front-ends spanning C-band, Ka-band, and millimeter-wave frequencies, so the ability to work across frequency regimes is essential.

What You'll Do

• Own the RF front-end architecture for the DT&E platform: signal chain topology, component selection, and interface definitions

• Design modular and testable receive and transmit signal chains: LNAs, PAs, TR switching, filtering, frequency conversion, and frequency synthesis, owning the cascade analysis, noise figure budget, linearity allocation, spurious plan, and power dissipation budget

• Develop frequency synthesis and LO distribution architectures that maintain phase coherence across multi-element systems, owning the trade-offs between integration, phase noise, spurious performance, and layout complexity

• Coordinate with the principal antenna engineer at the element

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Higher Education
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 https://www.g2.com/products/tremendous/reviews.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We're a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees- our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

As our Enterprise Account Executive, Higher Education, you will sell exclusively into colleges and universities across the United States and will have true ownership over the vertical. Tremendous has traction with universities today, but your efforts will be highly focused and directly influence how we approach this space moving forward.

While this role is focused on universities, this isn't one customer for Tremendous, it's several. You will focus on three motions that we know land: research teams paying study participants, HR teams running employee/student recognition, and student affairs departments issuing stipends. Win one of those on a campus, and you've got a credible path to the other two.

This role is roughly 70% new logo and 30% expansion. You're primarily a hunter, but the institutions you land become accounts that you can grow.

What you'll do:

- Hunt across an open territory. We have strong current traction, but you will own this space and determine how to grow our market share. Build a target list, segment it, and go after it deliberately.

- Sell three use cases well, help us discover more. Research participant payments, employee recognition, and student stipends. Know the pain, the buyer, and the objections for each one, and help us discover more uses in the higher ed space.

- Multi-thread relentlessly. One champion in one department is a nice first deal but a terrible account strategy. Map across campus, get referrals internally, and turn a single use case into three or more.

- Navigate the process. Higher Ed buys differently. You are comfortable with RFPs, procurement review, security questionnaires, and purchasing consortiums, and you know how to keep momentum while they run their process.

- Own your number. You'll carry a quota and a forecast you're accountable for, in a vertical where you decide where the pipeline comes from.

- Be ambitious. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. You'll be shaping how we go to market in a vertical we're investing in, which means growth in role and responsibility along with real personal upside.

You have:

- 4-6 years in SaaS sales, currently in a Mid-Market or Enterprise AE position

- A consistent track record of hitting quota

- Experience selling into higher education, public sector, or another committee-driven buying environment is a big plus (but not a requirement).

- You present well and you communicate clearly and concisely

- You have the business acumen to identify and create new sales opportunities, including new use cases inside accounts you've previously won

- You can self-source the majority of your own pipeline (the rest coming from SDR support and inbound).

- Comfort with longer, multi-stakeholder cycles without letting your pipeline go quiet

Why work with us:

- You'll work at a company growing quickly yet sustainably. We’re profitable with plenty more opportunity ahead. That’s good news for your career growth.

- Competitive pay, equity and benefits. The base salary for this role is $130,000 - $150,000. OTE is $260,000 - $300,000.

- We're a remote company. Work from wherever you want in the Americas.

- Smart people and a great culture. See our company handbook https://handbook.tremendous.com/.

title: Virtual Mental Health Therapist (Part-Time)
description:
The Problem

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

Who We Are
Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation that delivers specialty outpatient care for people living with severe mental illness, including schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, bipolar I disorder, and treatment-resistant depression. We design and operate high-acuity, in-person clinics across the United States.
Our model integrates psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community health workers under one roof to deliver coordinated, longitudinal care for a population that has historically been fragmented across systems.
Leading health systems collaborate with Amae to bring this model to their communities, including NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit Health.
Why We Are Different

• Integrated care, not a referral network. Psychiatrists, therapists, primary care providers, dietitians, and community health workers work side-by-side and share responsibility for the same patients.

• Practice at the top of your license. Manageable caseloads, meaningful clinical depth, and purpose-built tools designed for this population.

• Continuous learning. Through our collaboration with Mass General Brigham, clinicians receive ongoing training, supervision, and mentorship in evidence-based SMI care.

• A model built for sustainability. Team-based care, thoughtful caseloads, and strong infrastructure make this work meaningful-and sustainable over time.

We are hiring a Part-Time Virtual Mental Health Therapist (Fully Licensed or Associate-level) to support our members across California . In this fully virtual role, you'll deliver personalized, compassionate, high-quality group therapy to individuals living with serious mental illness (SMI), working as part of an interdisciplinary care team.
The schedule for this role is three days a week, mornings and evenings, plus additional time for documentation and administrative work.
The Opportunity:
You'll lead virtual group therapy for a panel of complex SMI patients across California, delivering evidence-based, holistic, wrap-around care. You'll work side-by-side with fellow therapists, psychiatrists, primary care providers, dietitians, and community health workers who share responsibility for the same patients, and you'll have access to ongoing training, supervision, and mentorship in evidence-based SMI care through Amae's academic medical center partnerships.

Provide individual therapy. Deliver individual psychotherapy when indicated as part of a member’s overall treatment plan.

•
Deliver evidence-based care. Integrate evidence-based approaches such as CBT, DBT, motivational interviewing, and other clinically appropriate interventions based on member needs.

•
Support members over time. Build therapeutic relationships and provide consistent support as members work toward recovery and functional goals.

description:
Who we are

More than just a workplace, we're a global community founded on strong relationships and the belief that meaningful work transforms lives. Our culture
At CloudFactory , we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

• People-centric: we care deeply about our team's growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.

• Innovative: we embrace change and find better ways to do things, together.

• Globally connected: we foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

Location: Brazil
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1-2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity
About the opportunity
CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.
The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.
As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.
How it works
If selected for the project:

• You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.

• Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.

• You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.

• You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1-2 hours.
You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.
Please note that this is a data validation activity only.
Requirements
To participate, you must:

• Be 18 years of age or older.

• Currently reside in Brazil.

• Be an active debit and/or credit card user.

• Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.

• Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.

• Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.

• Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.

• Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent
Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.
Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.
If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you

title: Senior Sourcer
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Join a team that’s changing financial services

Zocks is the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors. We help advisors automate their operational work and grow their business. 5,000+ firms use Zocks to turn client conversations into completed work.

We're a venture-backed team, building something that changes how financial advisors serve their clients every day. Every role here is an opportunity to shape the product, the company, and the way an entire industry works. We hire sharp, curious, and kind people who want to do meaningful work and build something from the ground up, together.

WHO YOU ARE

The SHARC in the room

At Zocks , we hire for SHARC - five qualities that define how our best people work and win together.

S - Sharp

You move fast without cutting corners. Quick decisions, thoughtful execution - you know when to act independently and when to loop in leadership.

H - Hungry

You're a self-starter who celebrates teammates as loudly as your own wins. Humble hustle is your default mode.

A - Adaptable

Startup life means things shift fast. You lean into change, pivot gracefully, and genuinely enjoy figuring out what's next.

R - Resilient

Building something new isn't always smooth. You bounce back stronger, see obstacles as puzzles, and never lose sight of the bigger picture.

C - Curious

You ask the questions others miss. You explore for fun, not just for work - and it shows in the quality of your thinking.

About the Role

Great candidates aren't always looking for a job. That's exactly the problem we're hiring you to solve.

We're looking for a Senior Sourcer to own outbound candidate strategy across our open roles - not a coordinator role, not a "manage the inbound queue" role. You'll build pipelines of passive candidates from scratch, run your own outreach campaigns, and partner directly with hiring managers and leadership on search strategy. Most of your day will be spent finding people who weren't thinking about a new job - and giving them a reason to start.

If you've ever built a search from absolutely nothing - no shortlist, no warm leads, just a blank sheet and a hunch about where the right person might be hiding - this is your kind of problem.

What You'll Do

• Own outbound sourcing for any role - senior or otherwise - where the pipeline is thin or inbound alone isn't cutting it

• Hunt down passive candidates using Boolean search, X-ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter, and whatever other channel gets the job done

• Run high-volume, genuinely personalized outreach campaigns and stick with long sourcing cycles that don't pay off overnight

• Have real conversations with the candidates you find, to sort signal from noise before handing off to the hiring manager

• Partner directly with hiring managers and leadership to figure out where outbound effort matters most

• Be the first impression of Zocks for people who've never heard of us - and make it a good one

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of sourcing experience, ideally from an agency, retained search firm, or an in-house team built around outbound

• Real fluency in Boolean/X-ray search and other passive-sourcing techniques - not just LinkedIn's built-in filters

• A track record of engaging and actually converting candidates who weren't looking

• Scrappiness - you don't wait for the perfect tool or a clean list; you figure out a way in

• Resourcefulness - when the obvious channel dries up, you find a less obvious one

• Comfort with a high volume of no's and silence - you treat it as data, not discouragement

• Adaptability - you can shift strategy mid-search when what you're doing isn't working

• Strong written communication - your outreach needs to stand out in a crowded inbox, not read like a template

• Full ownership mentality - you run a search end-to-end and don't need it handed to you in pieces

title: Virtual Assistant – eBay & Whatnot Listings
description:
Company Overview
The client has been a full-time reseller of toys and collectibles for 6-7 years, operating primarily on eBay with Whatnot as a secondary platform. The business focuses on hard goods - mostly action figures and collectibles (e.g. Marvel Legends) - and has been steadily growing. It has largely been a one-person operation, with occasional help from the owner's wife.
Role Overview
As inventory volume has grown, the owner can no longer keep up with creating listings at the pace he'd like. He's looking for a Virtual Assistant to take the listing-drafting work off his plate: turning product photos into ready-to-review listing drafts on eBay and Whatnot, so he can focus on sourcing, fulfillment, and growing the business. He will always do a final review and post the listings himself, so the goal is drafts that are as close to 'ready to launch' as possible.
Key Responsibilities

• Turn product photos sent by the client into listing drafts on eBay and Whatnot.

• Research and fill in accurate item details - title, brand, franchise, character, theme/family, and other item specifics - using tools like Google Lens and comparable/competitor listings, supplemented by information the client provides.

• Write eBay titles that follow the client's standardized style (e.g. 'Marvel Legends, Storm, action figure'), adapting to his preferences over time.

• Build out full eBay listings with the level of detail eBay's category/item-specifics fields require (theme, franchise, character family, etc.) so listings surface correctly in buyer searches.

• Build simpler Whatnot listings, which need far less detail - primarily an accurate title.

• Leave all listings in draft form for the client's final review, edits, and posting - not publish listings directly.

Skills & Tools

• Comfortable navigating eBay's listing tools and item-specifics/category fields; Whatnot experience a plus but not required.

• Resourceful at identifying unfamiliar items using tools like Google Lens and by cross-referencing similar/competitor listings.

• Detail-oriented and consistent - able to learn and replicate a standardized title/listing style over time.

• Comfortable working with toys, collectibles, and pop-culture/franchise items (Marvel, etc.); no prior fandom knowledge required, just willingness to learn.

• Reliable, reasonable turnaround on batches of photos sent by the client (same-day/next-day, not same-hour).

Logistics

• Starts at 10 hours/week, with potential to grow to 20-30+ hours/week as volume increases.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at  www.coreweave.com .

 

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

What You’ll Do:

The Physical AI Engineering Team at CoreWeave is building the software and infrastructure that enables demanding AI, simulation, robotics, and engineering workloads to run reliably at scale.

As these workloads become more complex, the challenge is no longer simply providing compute. We need to make heterogeneous workloads easier to execute, observe, reproduce, and move across different systems without hiding the capabilities or semantics of the infrastructure underneath them.

About the role:

We’re seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems to help design and build this layer.

This is a hands-on systems engineering role at the intersection of distributed systems, runtimes, workflow execution, programming language concepts, and large-scale compute infrastructure .

You’ll work on the foundations that allow complex workloads to move from an abstract description into reliable execution across systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, OSMO, and future execution environments.

A major part of the role is deciding where abstraction is useful - and where it creates more complexity. Rather than building another universal workflow engine, you’ll help establish clear contracts between our platform and the systems that execute work, while preserving native capabilities.

You’ll operate across architecture and implementation: defining contracts, writing production software, validating assumptions against real workloads, and working closely with platform and infrastructure teams.

In this role, you will:

• Runtime Systems & Architecture

• Design and build runtime components for complex AI, simulation, and engineering workloads.

• Define abstractions for workloads, execution environments, dependencies, state, capabilities, and failure.

• Design interfaces between higher-level services and systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, and OSMO.

• Establish clear boundaries around which systems own state, decisions, and side effects.

• Make architectural decisions balancing simplicity, extensibility, performance, and operational reality.

• Execution Models & Contracts

• Define durable contracts between workload definitions, control-plane services, and execution backends.

• Develop typed representations and schemas that allow workloads to be transformed safely across systems.

• Design compatibility and evolution mechanisms for those contracts.

• Build conformance and validation mechanisms that make guarantees executable rather than dependent on documentation.

• Reason deeply about retries, partial failure, idempotency, cancellation, dependencies, and uncertain outcomes.

• Hands-On Systems Engineering

• Write production-quality software for critical runtime and control-plane components.

• Build adapters and integrations for heterogeneous execution environments.

• Diagnose behaviour across application, orchestration, cluster, and infrastructure boundaries.

• Improve the reliability, observability, and debuggability of distributed workload execution.

• Work closely with Go, Kubernetes, and infrastructure engineers to turn architecture into production systems.

• Performance & Experimentation

• Develop rigorous ways to understand workload performance across large-scale GPU infrastructure.

• Design experiments that separate real performance gains from noise, warm-up effects, scheduling behaviour, and stragglers.

Centre de ressources de la Médiation numérique en Provence Alpes Côte d'Azur. L'association ARSENIC PACA reprend le dispositif HUB du SUD (Hub pour un numérique inclusif de l'ANCT) en 2022 avec pour vocation l'accompagnement des politiques publiques dans la mise en oeuvre de projet d'inclusion numérique et de médiation numérique sur les territoires.
Réseau régional des acteurs des médiations et de l’inclusion numériques depuis 2009, Arsenic relance son activité après une période réduite de deux ans.
Qu’il s’agisse du Plan France Relance, des dynamiques enclenchées par les Hubs pour un numérique inclusif ainsi que des dispositifs comme cele des Conseillers Numériques France Services ou d’Aidant Connect, l’accompagnement des populations sur leurs usages numériques est une partie intégrante des politiques publiques nationales et locales auxquelles Arsenic est appelé à prendre part.
Par conséquent, Arsenic, en tant que réseau historique et structurant doit de nouveau être pleinement opérationnel afin de proposer, accompagner et structurer ces dynamiques.

La mission sera réalisée en lien étroit avec les membres du Bureau de l’association, à la fois lors de réunions (présentielles et distancielles) et par l’intermédiaire de plateformes collaboratives en ligne.
Cette mission nécessite une autonomie importante de fonctionnement.

Orange Sky is the world’s first free mobile laundry and shower service, providing support to people experiencing homelessness and hardship. Launched in Aotearoa in 2018, after beginning in Australia, our kaupapa is to connect communities through working alongside service partners and community groups to uphold the dignity and mana of friends and whānau experiencing homelessness and hardship.
In Aotearoa, we are privileged to walk alongside whānau and communities in need, fostering genuine connections through clean clothes, warm showers, and meaningful kōrero. title: Support Systems Engineer
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Open to hiring remote across North America and London - we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, Seattle, and London.

We're building a tool that makes content creation easy and accessible for all types of creatives. Our users love it. Runway has an actively engaged and growing community of passionate artists and creators worldwide. And we're scaling the systems behind our support team so we can keep delivering delightful experiences as that community grows.

We're looking for a Support Systems Engineer who ships production code, not tickets and specs: someone who takes a fix from proposal to merged PR themselves. This role reports directly to the Head of Customer Experience.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own the AI support agent, our ticketing system and other Support tools end to end: authentication (JWT), response logic, routing, escalation paths and tone, tested in staging before it sees live traffic

- Ship daily product changes that remove ticket volume. Recent example: extending automatic refund eligibility to one-click credit purchases, accidental upgrades and month-based proration on annual terms

- Build and maintain internal CX tooling as real software, not one-offs: scripts, jobs, dashboards, admin surfaces

- Run QA and evals with real test suites and pass/fail rubrics, plus monitoring and alerts for outages, bugs and volume spikes

- Own releases: staged rollouts, a regression suite before every ship, clear rollback criteria, a writeup when something reaches production

- Build the CX reporting the org runs on: volume, deflection, CSAT, reply and resolution time, escalation accuracy, agent spend. You own the correctness and availability of the queries.

- Build and stage the guardrails on refunds, account changes and anything touching money or PII, including the audit trail

- Keep the knowledge base accurate and structured for the agent to parse, and manage the handoff into the ticketing system

- Keep the CX roadmap and the coverage model current, sequenced against priorities set by the Head of CX, so gaps show up before they bite

- Run the day-to-day with our AI platform vendor: weekly working session, joint roadmap, issues filed with reproductions

- Carry signal across teams: Product and Engineering on bugs and rollouts, Customer Education on self-serve, community on Discord and the forums, GTM and Analytics on routing and reporting

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- 5+ years in Customer Experience, Support Engineering or Support Operations, with real time spent writing code

- You ship production code in codebases you didn't write: read TypeScript, trace logic through someone else's service, put up a PR that survives review. Our stack is TypeScript and Node.js on AWS

- Hands-on experience building and tuning AI or LLM-powered support workflows: prompt and context engineering, routing, escalation design, evals

- SQL experience. You own the reporting, so you shouldn't be waiting on Analytics for it

- Code-level experience with a billing or payments A

ORGANIZATIONAL ALIGNMENT

They leverage artificial intelligence tools to improve the efficiency of business analysis, prototyping, functional design, user story creation, and documentation.

• Define user journeys, functional behaviors, business rules, validations, exception handling, and interactions between solution components.

• Translate business requirements and design mockups into clear, complete user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation that are ready for development.

• Break down features into deliverable increments and contribute to prioritization based on business value, user experience, risk, and implementation complexity.

• Participate in the functional modernization of solutions by assessing the business, operational, and technical impacts of proposed changes.

• Responsibly leverage artificial intelligence tools to accelerate analysis, research, prototyping, documentation, and user story development while exercising critical judgment and ensuring the quality of deliverables.

Communication & Collaboration (Approximately 25%)

title: eCommerce Digital Designer

At Sidekick , we help people recover faster from persistent injuries. Trusted by Olympic champions and everyday athletes, our products are featured in Men's Health and Running Magazine. With 94% of users finding relief, we aim to be the go-to injury relief brand.

• CRO knowledge

Benefits

Competitive Compensation: $3,000-4,000 USD/month + performance bonus

Big impact, fast - your work goes live within days and shows up directly in conversion numbers
